calibrated_with.shape_complementarity: VALIDATED for implementation (BIO Scientist, 2026-10-20, in-image, $0.00, nothing submitted). Recomputed under shape-complementarity==0.2.0 / sc-rs befcc6c on n=1,028 Nipah glycoprotein-G complexes: Pearson r=0.999959, Spearman rho=0.999945, mean |delta| 2.9e-4 SC units, 100% within +/-0.01, no signed offset. ROC-AUC vs measured BLI binding (100 binders/928 non-binders): ours 0.6873 [95% boot CI 0.6224,0.7480] vs Adaptyv column 0.6878 [0.6229,0.7479]; paired dAUC -0.00044 [-0.00109,+0.00016] (straddles zero, 4 orders narrower than the AUC CI). So shape-complementarity==0.2.0 REPRODUCES Adaptyv's quantity to float noise -> the 0.688 transfer STANDS and SC keeps its rank_average weight unchanged. STILL transferred ACROSS TARGET CLASS: Proteinbase has no pMHC, so the threshold is validated for implementation only, not for pMHC; campaign one remains its own calibration experiment. Caveat: Adaptyv's own SC parameters are an INFERENCE (proteinbase_README.md defines no params for the shape_complimentarity column); 'sc-rs at defaults' is read off 1,028 complexes agreeing to 2.9e-4, not off a spec, and only on the Nipah subset (1,028 of 4,273 PPIs). Report: /workspace/wetware/binder-design/v3/sc-recompute-2026-10-20.md (sha256 3ed7ea12f000...90c8cdf0).
calibrated_with.metric_code_reuse: Adaptyv competition_metrics is Apache-2.0 but computes only iPTM, pae_interaction, ESM2 PLL and a rank-average - no SC/SASA/H-bond/dG code, so only the pae_interaction definition and the rank-average convention are reusable
calibrated_with.used_for: every threshold and keep-fraction in layer 2

descriptors.calibration_note: Every roc_auc above is a threshold TRANSFERRED from Adaptyv's own columns, not computed under our stack. calibrated_with names the producing implementation per descriptor so a reproducible pin is never mistaken for a calibrated number. Campaign one is itself the calibration experiment.
descriptors.recompute_environment: Any descriptor recompute/recalibration MUST run inside the ghcr image ghcr.io/wetware-hq/bindi-fleet-env:2026-10-20 (numpy==2.4.6), NOT on the bare box (numpy 2.5.4). The box is now the divergent env; every descriptor number quoted before 2026-10-20 night was computed under 2.5.4, so an on-box recompute would inherit the flaw it is meant to settle.

shape_complementarity_parameters.source: read from sc-rs settings.rs at embedded checkout befcc6c (0.2.0 exposes no settings argument), not chosen by us
shape_complementarity_parameters.chains: B binder / A target, heavy atoms only, no HETATM, model 0
shape_complementarity_parameters.scale: Adaptyv publishes 0-100 (observed 30.94-69.15); sc-rs returns native 0-1; theirs is /100 (monotone unit convention, cannot affect Spearman or AUC)

descriptors.interface_definition_note: SC's interface is NOT our interface: sc-rs uses a native Connolly surface with nearest-neighbour dot pairing, while our ifd_* descriptors use a 5.0 A residue contact cutoff and a 1.4 A SASA probe. SC and the other rank-average descriptors are scoring interfaces defined two different ways. Defensible, but recorded so it is not discovered later.
descriptors.data_join_caveat: id is NOT unique in tidy.parquet (204 dupes: same designs counter-screened vs human serum albumin). A naive merge on id gives ~1,129 rows and silently mixes an off-target row into the on-target cohort. Filter target=='nipah-glycoprotein-g' first and assert one-to-one.
